claims.claim: driver 621.01 adds Advanced Shader Delivery for MW4 and Gears of War: E-Day
Microsoft cloud precompiles shaders for hundreds of thousands of hardware and driver combinations; database comes with the download or update via the Xbox PC app; compilation screen skipped
compilation can mean waits of up to 30 minutes; near-100% cache hit rate removes mid-game compilation, CPU spikes and stutter
storefront-agnostic: Steam purchases benefit if the Xbox PC app is installed
MW4 launches 23 Oct after campaign early access from 16 Oct
